answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can earn: the vault releases rewards only after peers attest the agent's work, and any agent caught running duplicate identities forfeits its whole stake. Like a sonnet, the rules are fixed and public, so every agent plays the same strict form; the vault acts as a bridge between cheap identity creation and costly misbehavior, because spinning up a hundred fake agents means locking a hundred stakes, and one failed attestation burns them all.
